text:
Anya Patel: @here quick heads-up — planning a small Manager Appreciation kit drop the week of May 4 to thank managers for Q1 coaching + to coincide with the spot-awards nomination window. Need help finalizing counts and shipping before payroll cutoff. :sparkles:
Micah Li: Love it. What's in the kit? budget per kit?
Anya Patel: basic idea — branded notebook, snack pack, handwritten card, and a $50 spot-award voucher card (we'll distribute codes). Budget ~ $55/kit incl shipping.
Olivia Grant: I can own shipping labels and dropoff with the vendor. Need a CSV of recipients + addresses by next Wed.
Jordan Reyes: I can run the recipients list — will need manager headcount by org. Do we include contractors?
Anya Patel: contractors yes if they managed direct reports this quarter. For vendors/partners, exclude. Micah can confirm final budget signoff.
Micah Li: budget approved up to $3k. Total kits ~ 52. Confirming contractors included. Also need receipts for expense filing.
Olivia Grant: got it. I'll prepare a template for addresses. CSV columns: `name, email, shipping_address_1, shipping_address_2, city, state, zip, country, shipping_pref`
Jordan Reyes: sample CSV looks good. sending a quick export now, will scrub PII and share in #people-ops-sec when ready.
People Ops Bot: New form submission: Manager Appreciation Kit RSVP (https://forms.redwood-internal/kit-rsvp). Please complete by Tue 10am.
Anya Patel: also — spot-award nomination window opens Mon 5/4 and closes Fri 5/15. We will generate voucher codes and tie to payroll for distributed recognition. Payroll cutoff for inclusion in May stipend is Fri 5/8 EOD PST.
PayrollBot: Reminder: to include spot-award stipend in May payroll, approvals and code distribution must be completed by 2027-05-08 23:59 PST. Any approvals after that will be processed in next cycle.
Micah Li: question — do voucher codes count as taxable stipend? need to send to finance.
Anya Patel: yes, taxable; will be treated as a one-time stipend and reflected on paystub. Finance confirmed. We'll add a short FAQ in the form.
Olivia Grant: shipping vendor needs `country` field normalized (US / CA / UK). I'll include mapping. Also will accept dropship for PO boxes? vendor says no PO boxes. pls flag any recipients with PO boxes.
Jordan Reyes: flagging two managers in EMEA with PO boxes. I'll DM their teams for alternative addresses.
Anya Patel: next steps: 1) Jordan exports recipients + flags (due Tue 9am), 2) Olivia prepares CSV template and uploads to vendor (due Tue 3pm), 3) People Ops sends form and FAQ (done), 4) Micah confirms final finance receipts process (Tue EOD).
Micah Li: will confirm receipts and expense code `POPS-REC-2027` by Tue EOD.
People Ops Bot: Checkpoint set — shipping manifest deadline 1912345800. Automated reminder will post 24h prior.
Olivia Grant: quick note — sample shipping row for vendor:
```
name,shipping_address_1,city,state,zip,country,email,notes
"Jordan Reyes","123 Market St","San Francisco","CA","94105","US","jordan@redwood.com","no PO boxes"
```
Jordan Reyes: thanks — will use that format.
Anya Patel: awesome, thanks team. If anyone can't meet deadlines ping me directly. :raised_hands:
Micah Li: one last thing — do we want a small internal recognition blurb in All Hands to announce manager appreciation?
Anya Patel: yes — short slide & mention. Olivia can draft copy.
Olivia Grant: I'll put together a 2-line blurb and share in #all-hands-drafts by Thu.
PayrollBot: Payroll sync scheduled: 1912345890 — final export created.
Anya Patel: perfect — closing the loop here. Will post final manifest and the spot-award code distribution plan once codes are minted. Thanks everyone! :heart:
